summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Vietnamese AI Verification Card landing page with new quiz game feature. All 17 required test points passed successfully on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.

accessibility_warnings.issue: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for screen reader accessibility
accessibility_warnings.impact: Radix UI best practice warning - does not affect functionality
accessibility_warnings.recommendation: Wrap dialog title with VisuallyHidden component or add explicit DialogTitle

passed_tests: Page loads at preview URL without functional errors
Hero section renders with Three.js canvas (data-testid: hero-three-bg) - no R3F errors
All 7 sections render in correct order: hero, game, theory, steps, apply, compare, footer
Sticky nav with scroll-spy functionality works correctly
Game intro: QR card displays with QR image from api.qrserver.com pointing to current URL + #game
Game intro: 'Đạt' and 'Cần kiểm chứng' explanation cards visible
Game intro: 'Bắt đầu chơi tại đây' button (data-testid: game-begin-button) works
Question screen: claim text displays correctly (data-testid: game-claim-text)
Question screen: 'Câu 1 / 8' badge shows current question number
Question screen: Two choice buttons present (data-testid: game-choice-pass, game-choice-verify)
Question screen: Scoreboard displays score=0, streak=🔥0, progress bar (data-testid: game-scoreboard, game-score, game-streak, game-progress)
Correct answer on Claim 1 ('Sinh viên dùng AI sẽ tăng 300%...') with 'Cần kiểm chứng' opens reveal dialog
Reveal dialog shows 'Chính xác' badge and 'Đáp án đúng: Cần kiểm chứng' (data-testid: game-reveal-dialog)
Reveal dialog displays 'Vì sao?' and 'Cách xử lý' sections
Reveal dialog 'Câu tiếp theo →' button advances to next question (data-testid: game-next-button)
Score updates correctly: 10 points for first correct answer
Streak mechanics: 2 correct answers in a row → streak=🔥2, score=22 (10 + 10 + 1*2 bonus)
Incorrect answer shows 'Chưa đúng' badge and resets streak to 🔥0
Score remains unchanged on incorrect answer (no points deducted)
All 8 questions can be completed successfully
Last question's next button shows 'Xem kết quả →' instead of 'Câu tiếp theo →'
Results screen appears after completing all 8 questions (data-testid: game-result-card)
Results screen displays correct count/total (e.g., '6 / 8')
Results screen shows percentage verdict with appropriate message
Results screen displays per-question history with correct/incorrect indicators
Results screen shows user's choice vs correct answer for each question
Replay button restarts game to Question 1 (data-testid: game-replay-button)
'Xem 5 bước kiểm chứng' button scrolls to steps section (data-testid: game-go-steps-button)
Theory section renders both 'Thực tiễn' and 'Chân lý' cards
5 Steps section renders with stepper/accordion functionality
Apply walkthrough section displays claim text at top (data-testid: apply-claim-text) with '300%' claim
Apply walkthrough tabs work correctly (data-testid: apply-tab-1, apply-tab-2, etc.)
Apply walkthrough detail view updates when switching tabs
Before/After comparison section renders both cards (data-testid: comparison-before, comparison-after)
Before/After cards display side-by-side on desktop
Before/After cards stack vertically on mobile
Footer section exists and is visible
Mobile (390x844): Page loads without errors
Mobile: Hero Three.js canvas renders without errors
Mobile: Game intro stacks correctly (text card on top, QR card below)
Mobile: Question screen is fully usable
Mobile: Reveal dialog displays correctly
Mobile: All sections render and stack appropriately
Mobile: Hamburger nav button opens sheet (data-testid: nav-mobile-menu)
Mobile: Nav sheet displays all navigation links
No R3F (React Three Fiber) errors in console
No ReactCurrentOwner errors in console
Three.js respects prefers-reduced-motion (animation disabled when user prefers reduced motion)
